annotations.text:
Quiet Ledger, colour-coded.
Every screen carries its own domain colour in a gradient header — Home teal, Transactions charcoal, Budget indigo, Money to get back gold, Scheduled blue, Net worth plum — and the tab bar picks up that colour too, so you know where you are before reading a word.

Quick actions sit directly under the balance, and accounts run as a horizontal carousel so each currency keeps its own figure instead of collapsing into one lump sum. Category colours repeat down every list in the app.

This one is live — tap More options, then the Need this money back toggle.
Only Amount, Paid to, Category, Paid using and Date come before Save.
Personal and Household carry separate budgets. Home shows Household (₹1,51,400 of ₹1,75,000); Budget shows Personal (₹64,200 of ₹1,00,000). The totals differ on purpose.
Nothing here is an expense until it is confirmed paid. Hijri-scheduled items keep their Hijri rule and show the Gregorian date beside it.
A card payment stays grey with no minus sign wherever it appears — it moves money, it does not spend it, and it must never re-count as an expense.
Twelve steps, every one skippable, and nothing is trapped in setup — all of it stays editable later.
